notes: Company snapshot: mid-market ecom personalization vendor; personalization + live chat features for 1000s of merchants.
Primary ask: reproducible perf benchmarks for <120ms p95 end-to-end chat (accepting tradeoffs on p99), and a path to cut token cost by 40% via batching/caching/quantization.
Workload details: chat sessions w/ short context windows (~128 tokens), frequent repeated prefixes (product catalog snippets), heavy reranking at checkout (top-10 -> top-3).
Throughput target: sustained 200 qps for chat endpoint during peak; burst to 800 qps for flash sales - want predictable SLOs.
Latency SLOs: p95 < 120ms for interactive UI; p99 budget ~400ms acceptable w/ graceful degradation.
Cost sensitivity: aiming to reduce per-conversation token cost by ~35-50% compared to current gpt-3.5-hosted setup. Important to show unit economics for 6 and 12 month horizons.
Model preferences: prefer open weights (Llama-2 family) + Redwood-verified variants; willing to evaluate 7B/13B quantized models and a small fallback (3B) for high-load conditions.
Routing / fallback: need automated fallback policy — prefer dedicated pool -> cheaper shared -> fallback small model in another region. Must be configurable by route/tenant.
Caching plan: interested in prefix/KV caching at request layer (catalog snippets) and session-level KV cache for multi-turn. Ask: cache invalidation controls and TTL tuning.
Batching strategy: want smart batching that respects per-tenant latency SLOs; evaluate continuous batching size/flush thresholds vs tail latency impact.

Quantization: very interested in int8 / GPTQ-style quantization; must validate quality regression on product titles and checkout messages (precision loss unacceptable beyond 2% BLEU-like metric or business metric drop).

Benchmark requests: they requested bench against Llama-2-13B (fp16), Llama-2-13B-int8, Llama-2-7B-int8, and a 3B fallback. Tests: synthetic spike, steady-state 200 qps, and caching-hit scenarios. Measure latency (p50/p95/p99), cost per 1k tokens, and hallucination/regression on 200 prompt evals.
Security notes: SSO via Okta required, KMS integration for keys, audit logs required for admin actions and token usage, retention controls for chat transcripts (30/90/365 day tiers).
Quote from CTO: 'If Redwood can show a clear path to our Q2 cost goals without sacrificing UX, we can roll Dedicated for prod in Q3.'
Internal: AE to push procurement timeline; SE to prepare bench harness and test vectors (product snippets + checkout flows).
